about: ^report(46): the same small edits on the Witch slide, with the page's timeline (Util.BenchMarks) and now the worker's own (ServerMessage.Timeline: 'worker: ' marks, on the page's clock; a run of slices with its evaluator's share, eval_ms; each message shared, encoded and posted, with its size), and each large answer broken down (AnswerParts, answer_parts: each part's size estimated by a walk and scaled to the bytes that crossed; parts that share values each count them). Times in ms from the edit. A run of slices that posts the result is recorded after the timeline it is in is sent, so it shows in the next edit's marks, before that edit; the evaluator's time is the result's eval_ms. Firefox on GitHub's machines, a release build, the Witch slide only (workflow_dispatch, only=Witch).
